name: focus-stack
description: Blend 2–4 supplied, already pixel-aligned focus-bracket stills using measured local contrast and feathered source selection. Confirm that the images show the same scene and are aligned; equal dimensions alone do not prove registration. Export a composite PNG, a source-index PNG before feathering and a provenance report in a ZIP. Supply opaque JPEG, PNG or WebP files with identical oriented dimensions: 32–1024 pixels per side, 20 MB per file and 32 MB combined. No automatic alignment, deghosting, physical depth or new detail. Noise, exposure and sharpening can affect focus scores; halos, seams and ghosts may remain. Requires a connected account; derived exports are public.
